releaseNotesEmpty: This version has no release notes
releaseNotesUnavailable: Failed to load the release notes
releaseNotesTimeout: Timed out loading the release notes
bothSourcesMissing: This repository has no CHANGELOG, and this version has no release notes
changelogTimeoutHint: Poor network, or this repository has no CHANGELOG
commitsAccelerationUnsupported: The GitHub acceleration service may not support fetching commits for the selected range
packageUnavailable: Failed to load the bazaar package info
preferredSourceTip: Which source the changelog dialog opens with.
botReleaseNotesTip: Release notes whose only line is a "Full Changelog: v1.0.1...v1.0.2" link (usually auto-generated) count as no release notes; the dialog opens the commit range they point to instead.
githubReferencesTip: Render #123, owner/repo#123, @user and URLs in release notes, the CHANGELOG and commits as clickable links.
githubAccelerationTip: When off, only api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com are requested. When on, release notes, CHANGELOG and commit requests all go through the acceleration URL below.
githubAccelerationURLTip: A prefix proxy prepended to the original URL, for example https://gh-proxy.com/ .
githubTokenTip: The token is stored encrypted in the plugin's private storage and is only sent with requests to api.github.com; with GitHub acceleration on, requests are relayed by a third-party proxy and carry no token. Create one in GitHub's Developer settings; reading public repositories only needs read-only access.
tokenNeedsSecureContext: This context has no Web Crypto, so the token cannot be stored encrypted; use the desktop app or https.
debugModeTip: Print complete plugin logs to the console.
